text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear claim in the opening and repeated support for driverless cars","quality":"stance clarity","description":"The essay states its position early and keeps that position visible throughout the piece."},{"evidence":"Uses article facts like \"half a million miles without a crash\" and specific features of the cars","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay grounds its argument in details from the source rather than relying mostly on opinion."},{"evidence":"Explains safety, convenience, and reduced accidents in separate paragraphs","quality":"development of reasons","description":"The essay gives multiple supporting points and expands each one instead of listing ideas briefly."},{"evidence":"Connects claims to article details such as driver alerts, steering, braking, and seat vibration","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay adds explanatory detail that helps show how the evidence supports the position."},{"evidence":"Includes an intro, body paragraphs, and a concluding call to action","quality":"overall organization","description":"The essay has a more complete argumentative structure with clearer movement from opening claim to wrap-up."},{"evidence":"Frequent direct address and emphatic closing lines","quality":"persuasive voice","description":"The essay sounds more intentionally argumentative and tries to engage the reader more forcefully."}]}
